propositions: test_perf asserts a fixed 50ms wall-clock budget on a single run of retrieve() over 300 digests.
The single-sample measurement flakes under CI runner CPU scheduling contention, failing the Verified gate for unrelated changes.
The function's true cost is fast (~1.6ms median locally), so inflated CI samples reflect transient contention rather than algorithmic regression.
Fix measures minimum elapsed across N>=5 runs (best-of-N) and asserts min < budget, removing the single-sample assertion.
A simulated transient stall on one sample must no longer fail the assertion.
A sustained/uniform slowdown representing a real regression must still fail the assertion.
